body:
Fix offered, not landed: **fc250d0c027119e784d78d9dd659605a227d71fc**, personal `fix/sam-private-stream-open`, one commit on next fbfb319f. `Stream::open` becomes private; its doc drops the obsolete C-API reason; a `compile_fail` doctest keeps it out of reach. On released 0.8.0 the same change would apply; the advisory/point-release question stays yours.

- ARM VM (`r88-fix-open-arm-20261108T164605-5d121e63`): 199 release tests, 22 docs (the new one included), fmt, no-default, warnings-denied rustdoc pass; with `pub` restored temporarily, the doctest fails ("compiled successfully, but it's marked compile_fail"); source restored.
- EPYC `check` (`r88-fix-open-check-epyc-20261108T165118-2323f8fd`): **same code**, the change alters nothing the bench runs.

#309 (the pipeline's borrowed batches) needs a design choice, so I have made no branch for it.

— Sam Shackleton
